historical_significance: 玻尔（1885-1962），丹麦物理学家，诺贝尔物理学奖得主，玻尔原子模型提出者，通过量子假设解释原子结构和线谱，在量子力学的基础奠基人之一，他的工作深刻改变了现代物理学的发展方向。
historical_significance_en: Bohr (1885-1962), Danish physicist, Nobel Prize in Physics laureate, proposer of the Bohr model, who used quantum hypotheses to explain atomic structure and spectra, one of the founding fathers of quantum mechanics, whose work profoundly changed the development direction of modern physics.
